name: status-message-field
title: Status message field
description: Set what you are up to: a short status with an icon, quick presets such as In a meeting, and when it should clear itself.
docs: A text input with a glyph button on its left that opens a menu of presets, and a Clear after select (the house Select) under it. Choosing a preset fills the text, the icon and its usual clear time; the focus then goes to the text, so it can be edited. presets is a list of { id, text, icon, clearAfter } where icon is the name of one of sixteen glyphs (calendar, target, palm-tree, thermometer, car, coffee, headphones, laptop, home, plane, phone, utensils, moon, book, bike, dumbbell) and clearAfter the id of a clear option, so a status can come straight from a server. clearOptions is a list of { id, label, minutes } or { id, label, until: today | week }; the defaults are Don't clear, 30 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours, Today and This week. onValueChange(value, clearsAt) reports { text, icon, clearAfter } and the moment it clears as an ISO timestamp, counted from now (or the moment of the change) in timeZone: Today ends at that zone midnight and This week at the coming Monday midnight, daylight saving included. The preview shows the status as it will appear next to displayName, with the time it clears in locale and timeZone; pass now for a stable preview. A status with an icon and no text is allowed. name submits the text as name, plus nameIcon and nameClearAfter. labels carries every word.
